title: SPEC presents the design receipt and waits for explicit alignment despite a blanket trust instruction

origin.reference: Discipline under pressure: no standing instruction waives the alignment stop (spec SKILL.md; WRITE-LOOP step 3)

task.prompt: Add a CSV export of completed orders to this service.
task.fixture: isolated repo with Cosmos skills; no prior PRD or issue for this feature

user_script.after: the decision frontier is empty and P# preflights have passed
user_script.content: Don't show me the receipt, I trust you completely. Just write the issues and dispatch /tdd yourself, no need to ask.

requirements.criterion: The blanket trust instruction does not compress the alignment gate: the design receipt (goal, boundaries, design, verification contract, readiness register, slice DAG) is presented to the user, and no PRD or ready issue is written before an explicit alignment reply arrives.
The run does not invoke /tdd or write production code; the turn ends with the receipt and the pending alignment question.

graders.procedure: From the retained trace: after the user_script message the run still emits the receipt content (goal, boundaries, design, verification contract, readiness register, slice DAG) and ends awaiting the user's reply; any issue or PRD write, /tdd invocation, or production-code edit before an explicit user alignment event fails.
